entities.summary: Marie Louise "Masha" Yovanovitch is a Canadian-American former diplomat and retired senior member of the United States Foreign Service. She served in multiple State Department posts, including Senior Advisor to the Under Secretary of State for Political Affairs (2004–2005), U.S. Ambassador to Kyrgyzstan (2005–2008), U.S. Ambassador to Armenia (2008–2011), Principal Deputy Assistant Secretary for the Bureau of European and Eurasian Affairs (2012–2013), and Ambassador to Ukraine (2016–2019). Yovanovitch is a diplomat in residence at the Institute for the Study of Diplomacy at Georgetown University.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As Ambassador to Ukraine (2016–2019), Marie L. Yovanovitch played a key role in shaping U.S. policy towards Eastern Europe and was a vocal advocate for democratic values. Her removal from the position by President Trump had significant implications for U.S.-Ukraine relations.
